name: Napier Port Holdings Limited
summary: Napier Port Holdings Limited provides various port services in New Zealand. The company's port services include marine, general cargo, cruise, container, port pack, and depot services. It also provides shipping connection, crane driver training, and port tech solutions. The company provides and manages port services and cargo handling infrastructure through Napier Port. Napier Port Holdings Limited was founded in 1855 and is based in Napier, New Zealand. Napier Port Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Hawke's Bay Regional Investment Company Limited.
